fonts.display: 'Egyptienne F LT', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Diatype', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, filled buttons, dark inverse surfaces, hairlines, logo mark. The single darkest token in the system — a warm near-black that reads as ink, not pure black

palette.name: Paper Warm
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Paper Cool
palette.role: Tertiary surface tint, alternating row backgrounds, inset wells. Slightly cooler than Paper Warm — used sparingly to create layered depth without color

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Subtle dividers, low-contrast borders, badge fill backgrounds, hover wash on neutral surfaces. Sits one step lighter than Paper Warm for hairline detail work

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Muted body copy, secondary metadata, disabled labels, low-emphasis icon strokes. The mid-warm-gray that keeps supporting text legible without competing with Ink

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Link text and link borders for in-content references. A step lighter than Ink, used only when a link needs to feel slightly less assertive than the primary type

palette.name: White
palette.role: Page canvas, button text on Ink fills, nav background, card image overlay text. The paper the whole system is printed on
